structured_output.summary: The change implements each spec step in order with `?` propagation. It validates the typed array, takes its length, converts the index with a local ToAbsoluteIndex, returns undefined when the index is out of range, and otherwise calls TypedArrayGetElement. The local ToAbsoluteIndex helper is allowed by the ticket. It matches the spec: ToIntegerOrInfinity with `?`, then add length if the value is finite and negative. The length is captured before index coercion, as the spec requires, so a resize or detach during `valueOf` is handled by the element-lookup helper's validity check. I did not see that helper's code. The only remaining failures are two BigInt not-implemented errors in resizable-buffer.js, which come from other parts of the engine. The gate shows +22 passes and no regressions.
